relationships.description: Orchestrator routes tasks to specialised agents over the A2A protocol.
Jira (or a CI/CD system) calls the orchestrator webhook endpoints to start workflows.

jira-webhook-hmac.description: Webhook requests must carry a valid X-Hub-Signature HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body; invalid or missing signatures are rejected.

config.name: Jira Webhook HMAC Signature
config.description: Inbound Jira webhook payloads are authenticated with an HMAC-SHA256 signature.

relationships.description: Orchestrator calls the external LLM provider for agent selection.
Orchestrator reports test execution results to Zephyr.
Requirements Review Agent reads Jira data through the Jira MCP server.
Jira MCP server communicates with the external Jira instance.
Incident Creation Agent requests embeddings from the embedding service.
Jira RAG Update Agent requests embeddings from the embedding service.
Incident Creation Agent queries Qdrant for duplicate detection.
Jira RAG Update Agent writes embeddings to Qdrant.
Internal services are deployed as Cloud Run services.
